# Workflows
Workflows define the procedure an agent follows. The router selects one primary workflow and adds specialist workflows only when their trigger applies.

| Workflow | Purpose | Status |
|---|---|---|
| [Architecture Design](workflow-architecture-design.md) | Choose and validate durable system boundaries, protocols, components, and technology decisions. | `stable` |
| [Architecture Migration](workflow-architecture-migration.md) | Move between architecture states through reversible compatibility-aware delivery slices. | `stable` |
| [Incident Response](workflow-bug-fix-incident-response.md) | Contain production impact, preserve evidence, restore safely, and separate mitigation from durable repair. | `stable` |
| [Regression-First Bug Fix](workflow-bug-fix-regression-first.md) | Reproduce a defect, protect it with regression evidence, and implement the smallest safe correction. | `stable` |
| [Multi-Agent Task Decomposition](workflow-collaboration-multi-agent-decomposition.md) | Split parallel agent work across stable boundaries with explicit ownership and integration order. | `stable` |
| [Task Handoff](workflow-collaboration-task-handoff.md) | Transfer deterministic project state, evidence, risks, and one exact next step between sessions or agents. | `stable` |
| [Database and Schema Change](workflow-database-schema-change.md) | Deliver compatible, observable, restartable, and recoverable schema or data migrations. | `stable` |
| [Test-Driven Feature Development](workflow-feature-tdd.md) | Deliver the smallest useful feature slice through observable test-first behaviour. | `stable` |
| [Deterministic Development Workflow](workflow-general-deterministic-development.md) | Run one coherent development iteration from context and planning through validation, reporting, and next-step selection. | `stable` |
| [Documentation-Only Change](workflow-general-documentation-change.md) | Update documentation against verified behaviour with runnable examples and link validation. | `stable` |
| [Execution Planning](workflow-general-execution-planning.md) | Decompose one approved milestone into dependency-aware, independently reviewable slices and one first step. | `stable` |
| [Project Planning](workflow-general-project-planning.md) | Turn a broad project idea into an approved outcome, MVP, roadmap, milestones, risks, and first deterministic step. | `stable` |
| [Release and Dependency Maintenance](workflow-general-release-maintenance.md) | Prepare releases and dependency changes with compatibility, packaging, validation, and rollback evidence. | `stable` |
| [Technical Investigation](workflow-general-technical-investigation.md) | Resolve a bounded technical unknown through reproducible evidence rather than production implementation. | `stable` |
| [Skill Authoring and Registry Lifecycle](workflow-governance-skill-authoring-lifecycle.md) | Propose, review, version, deprecate, replace, and retire reusable skills through explicit compatibility evidence. | `stable` |
| [Measurement-First Performance Optimisation](workflow-performance-measurement-first.md) | Optimise a measured bottleneck against a reproducible benchmark and preserve a regression guard. | `stable` |
| [Characterisation-First Refactoring](workflow-refactoring-characterisation-first.md) | Improve structure in reversible steps while characterisation tests protect existing behaviour. | `stable` |
| [UI and Mobile Vertical Slice](workflow-ui-mobile-vertical-slice.md) | Deliver one complete accessible user flow across presentation, domain, and infrastructure boundaries. | `stable` |
